label: exploratory
description: Smoke matrix of protocol section 6.1 (S1, S4; lambda 0, 0.5; budgets 1, 3, 9; DELIB 6; 2 seeds of 200 items; seed entropy 0) at code revision 9bfb9d3.
outcome: 8 runs, 0 excluded, all invariants true. Runtime 0.16 s (earlier dirty-tree run 0.09 to 0.11 s); peak RSS 39.5 MiB. Outputs results/exploratory/smoke/ (results.json, metrics.csv, run_manifest.json, report.md, report.pdf 4 pages, figure). Observed degenerate behaviour: DELIB at budget 6 had exactly the accuracy of MV at 3 in every cell; CW was far above MV in all four cells. Not a finding.

label: exploratory
kind: engine validation probe (EXP-001 draft design, exploratory seeds)
description: PROBE-EXP001: engine MV accuracy against closed forms for independent, common-shock (lambda 0 to 1), mixture (S4 to S6) and Bahadur cells, n in {1,3,5,9,15,31}, 10 seeds x 20,000 items, tolerance 4 SE, seed entropy 0 (not the confirmatory entropy).
outcome: 4 golden fixtures reproduced; 292 Monte Carlo cells run, 20 Bahadur cells excluded as inadmissible (c = 0.1 at n = 31; c = 0.4 at n = 9, 15, 31), 0 cells outside 4 SE, max |z| = 2.427. Runtime 40.12 s at revision 9bfb9d3 (12.74 s on an earlier dirty-tree run of the same code; the machine was shared with other sessions); peak RSS 519.5 MiB. Exploratory verification, not the frozen EXP-001.

label: exploratory
description: PROBE-SEED-SPREAD: smoke-matrix cells (S1, S4; lambda 0, 0.5) at the planned run size (2000 items, 10 seeds, budgets 1 to 31, DELIB 6 to 30), seed entropy 0.
outcome: 40 runs, 0 excluded. Mean per-run simulation time 0.013 s (max 0.019 s) in a first dirty-tree run (total 0.73 s) and 0.051 s (max 0.149 s) in the committed clean-tree rerun at revision 9bfb9d3 (total 2.47 s including bootstrap summaries; the machine was shared with other sessions); peak RSS 88.0 MiB. Projected EXP-002 full matrix (240 runs): about 3 to 12 s of simulation plus summaries, well under one minute; at 30 seeds (720 runs) about 10 to 40 s plus summaries. Between-seed SD of Delta in non-baseline cells (budget > 1): MV 0.0065 to 0.0137 (median 0.0090), SEQ 0.0067 to 0.0179 (median 0.0103), CW 0.0057 to 0.0131, DELIB 0.0065 to 0.0128. With the largest MV/SEQ SD (0.0179) the 10-seed t half-width is 0.0128, above the protocol's 0.01 threshold; 15 seeds give 0.0099, 20 give 0.0084, 30 give 0.0067. Not a finding.

label: exploratory

outcome: Runtime 30.3 s, peak RSS 211 MiB. Design property: 9 of 48 Bahadur cells are inadmissible ((r = 0.2, n = 15) and (r = 0.4, n = 9 or 15) for each p); all mixture cells are admissible.
